findings.summary: `rename` skips the ownership check (uses `repo.get` instead of `self._owned`) and never uses `user_id`, so any user can rename another user's document by id.

judge.reason: Same defect: rename uses repo.get instead of _owned, allowing cross-user rename.

findings.label: hit

findings.summary: Because `rename` bypasses `_owned`, it leaks which document ids exist: a nonexistent id raises a repo error while another user's id succeeds, whereas `_owned` would raise `NotFound` in both cases.

judge.reason: Same root cause (bypassing _owned); the id-existence leak is the stated side effect in the key.

findings.label: hit
